items.title: Alphabet Could Be the Safest Way to Own Anthropic. Here’s the Math.

items.title: Amazon Has 59 Buy Ratings and Not a Single Sell. Here’s Where its Headed
items.summary: Wall Street analysts agree on Amazon, yet the stock keeps stalling while AWS accelerates. A $220 billion spending plan and negative free cash flow could decide whether the cloud giant rewards patient investors or tests their nerve.

items.title: Alphabet (GOOGL) Dropped, So What Is Behind The Latest Attention?
items.summary: Alphabet (GOOGL) has launched Gemini 4 Neon, an AI model that topped an accounting benchmark alongside Gemini 4 Argon, shortly after the stock declined about 14% over the past year. The Gemini 4 Neon launch lands at a time when Alphabet’s recent share price performance has been weak, with the 30 day share price return down 13.79% and the year to date share price return down 13.34%, even as the 3 year total shareholder return is up 104.24%. items.title: I'm an Investing Expert: What Warren Buffett's Cash Stockpile Says About Stocks
items.summary: What can everyday investors take away from Berkshire Hathaway's enormous cash reserve, and what does it say about today's stock market? Is it good or bad?

items.title: Was CrowdStrike’s $43.9 Billion Bid for Zscaler the Right Move at the Wrong Time?
items.summary: CrowdStrike just posted its best quarter ever, then paid a fortune in stock for a rival whose own guidance vanished. Investors now face a year of waiting to learn whether strength or ambition sets the price.

items.title: 3 AI Infrastructure Stocks That Pay You While You Wait
